observations: SLES, Cocamidopropyl Betaine and TEA-Dodecylbenzenesulfonate form the cleanser system.
Dimethiconol, Dimethicone and cationic guar form a meaningful deposition cluster.
Piroctone Olamine appears after the main silicone/cationic system and before the preservative tail.
The exact 300 ml GTIN and formula are grounded by two matching current German exact-GTIN retailer records; no current official German ingredient page was located.
